dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: I don't get it. This has got everything children like, all in one...

dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: I'm talking about a toy, actually. It's something that you can assemble yourself, it transforms, and it flies too. Tell me, surely a kid would like it?

dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: You think so too...? *Sigh* But for some reason the toys just aren't flying off the shelves. I've spent so much time on them, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: "A set of nesting dolls that can be assembled, transform, and even fly!" All the things kids like, all in one toy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not quite sure about that.

dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: Oh? So I should add another feature then? That'd be a little neither here nor there, don't you think...

dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: "A set of nesting dolls that can be assembled, transform, and even fly!" My assessment is that's quite enough features for a toy. But for some reason, nobody's buying them...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe the problem is with the nesting dolls...

dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: That's impossible! There's nothing wrong with the nesting dolls, nothing at all...
